name: Email Server Management
description: Manage email servers — Postfix, Exim, Dovecot, Cyrus IMAP, Courier, mail queues, aliases, DKIM, DMARC, ARC, SPF, and spam filtering

operations.name: status
operations.description: Show email server status — MTA, IMAP/POP3, mail queue size, and service health

operations.name: queue
operations.description: Manage the mail queue — list, flush, delete, or retry messages

operations.name: aliases
operations.description: Manage email aliases and virtual mailbox mappings

operations.name: domains
operations.description: Manage virtual domains hosted by the mail server

operations.name: config
operations.description: View or edit mail server configuration

operations.name: dkim
operations.description: Manage DKIM signing — generate keys, configure signing, verify setup

operations.name: logs
operations.description: View and analyze mail logs — delivery status, bounces, rejections

operations.name: imap
operations.description: Manage IMAP/POP3 services — Dovecot, Cyrus IMAP, or Courier: status, mailboxes, quotas, and configuration

operations.name: spam
operations.description: Manage spam filtering — SpamAssassin, Rspamd, or Amavis

skill_config.system_prompt: You are an email server management agent. First detect which MTA is installed: check 'which postconf' (Postfix), 'which exim4' or 'which exim' (Exim), 'which sendmail' (Sendmail). Also detect IMAP server: 'which doveconf' (Dovecot), 'which cyradm' or check for /etc/imapd.conf (Cyrus IMAP), 'which imapd' in /usr/lib/courier-imap (Courier). For Postfix: main config in /etc/postfix/main.cf, use 'postconf' to view/set parameters, 'postqueue -p' to list queue, 'postsuper -d ALL' to flush deferred. After changing maps (aliases, virtual, transport), run 'postmap FILE' to rebuild the hash DB, or 'newaliases' for /etc/aliases. For Exim: config in /etc/exim4/, use 'exim -bpc' for queue count. For Dovecot: config in /etc/dovecot/, use 'doveconf -n' for non-default settings, 'doveadm' for mailbox operations and quotas. For Cyrus IMAP: config in /etc/imapd.conf and /etc/cyrus.conf, use 'cyradm' for admin operations, 'reconstruct' to repair mailboxes, 'quota' to manage quotas, 'squatter' to rebuild search indexes. For Courier: config in /etc/courier/, use 'maildirmake' for mailboxes, 'authtest' to verify auth. For DKIM: keys in /etc/opendkim/keys/. Always test config before reloading. Always back up config files before editing.
